LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NothingToAssign: Nothing to assign: every colonist is locked or kept. Uncheck "Keep current loadouts" or unlock colonists.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_RolesOnlyNoRoles: "Roles only" is on, but no roles exist yet. Click to create one in the Roles tab, or switch the setting off.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NoLoadoutsExist: No weapon can be assigned: nothing usable is owned or craftable. Get weapons first, or pick one for a colonist by hand in Equip Colonists.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_UnassignedNoOwned: {0} colonist(s) get no weapon: not enough owned weapons. Move the slider toward "Craft new items".
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_UnassignedNoProducible: {0} colonist(s) get no weapon: not enough owned or craftable weapons. Research or build more weapon types.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NoAntiMechOption: No anti-mech option among the candidates: nothing fires EMP or AP/Sabot ammunition. Give a colonist such ammo in the Ammo window, or add an EMP grenade as a sidearm.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NoAntiFleshOption: No dedicated anti-flesh option among the candidates: nothing carries incendiary/HE/frag ammunition. Standard rounds still work against flesh, so this is only a hint.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NoMeleeLoadouts: No melee weapon is available, so "Prefer melee" has nothing to hand out. Get a melee weapon first.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NoRangedLoadouts: No ranged weapon is available, so "Prefer ranged" has nothing to hand out. Get a ranged weapon first.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_FewWeaponGroups: Only {0} weapon group(s) among the candidates - there is little to diversify. Research or build more weapon types.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_WeakColonistsProblem: {0} colonist(s) got a loadout but currently can't aim or fight (downed, injured or paralysed): {1}. Lock them if this is permanent.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_OverloadedProblem: {0} colonist(s) get a loadout that does not fit them ({1}). They will only pick up what fits and leave the rest - the loadout stays partly unfulfilled.
LanguageData.CER_AssignPlanner_NoRolesNoPlain: No weapon can be assigned: nothing usable is owned or craftable, and "No roles" leaves out every role.
